evaluation_config.gate_interpretation: Engineering screening criteria; not confidence levels, significance tests, or proof of prospective skill.

gates.interpretation: Engineering screening criteria; not confidence levels, significance tests, or proof of prospective skill.

limitations: Retrospective reconstructed forecasts; no live-issued prospective test or held-out future record.
The fixed model was designed after observing market history; retrospective holdouts do not erase researcher knowledge.
Calendar years, weekly horizons and BTC/ETH share outcomes and regimes; reported row counts are not independent sample sizes.
Causal drawdown/reclaim-ATH episodes and nonoverlapping target counts are dependence diagnostics, not independent cycle guarantees.
Historical daily USD reference closes can be revised; this evaluation does not reconstruct every original publication vintage.
Frozen annual blocks permit only training labels available plus the embargo by January 1; test-year labels are never used within that block.
No tuning or best-horizon selection is performed; all horizons and recovery states are retained, including failures.
Passing engineering gates would require separate review and prospective monitoring; this artifact never authorizes trading or sizing.

redactions: Absolute local input paths replaced with logical source-file names. No scores, gates, hashes, or failures removed.
publication.source_semantics: Production data_loader._read_wide BTC/ETH series, using the archive and same price overlay stitching as the dashboard; rows without asset prices omitted, with no subsequent forward fill. UTC daily closes only, available the following midnight. This is a current reconstructed data snapshot, not a historical publication-vintage archive.
